cues.en: The good news is that there's very little to learn in this section.
cues.zh: 好消息是，這一章要學的新東西很少。

cues.en: Instruction tuning is different from fine tuning only because the data sets look different, but instruction
cues.zh: 指令微調與一般微調的差別，只是資料集長得不同；但指令

cues.en: tuning is still based on next token prediction, negative log likelihood loss functions, and gradient descent.
cues.zh: 微調仍以預測下一個詞元、負對數概似損失，以及梯度下降為基礎。

cues.en: Here again is the table that I've shown at the beginning of the previous two sections, just as a reminder.
cues.zh: 這裡再次展示前兩章開頭的表格，提醒一下。

cues.en: The goal of instruction tuning is to create chatbots and assistants that can interact with users with
cues.zh: 指令微調的目標，是建立聊天機器人與助理，讓它們與使用者、

cues.en: humans in ways that are similar to how humans would interact with each other.
cues.zh: 與人類互動的方式，類似人與人之間的互動。

cues.en: Now, this has a lot to do with teaching models about high level patterns in text, like questions and answers or ongoing dialogue with the user.
cues.zh: 這主要是教模型理解文字中的高階模式，例如問答，或與使用者持續對話。

cues.en: The data sets used for instruction Tuning generally come from humans writing out scripts that they would want the interaction with the LLM to look like.
cues.zh: 指令微調的資料集，一般來自人類撰寫的腳本，呈現他們希望與 LLM 如何互動。

cues.en: But most of instruction tuning is still just based on next token prediction.
cues.zh: 但指令微調大部分仍只是以預測下一個詞元為基礎。

cues.en: There is another set of techniques called reinforcement learning from human feedback, and I will describe
cues.zh: 另外還有一類技術，稱為人類回饋強化學習，我會在本章最後

cues.en: it briefly at the end of this section, although I'm not going to go into the mathematical or implementational details.
cues.zh: 簡短介紹，但不會深入數學或實作細節。

cues.en: You can think of a hierarchy of training llms as something like this.
cues.zh: 可以把 LLM 訓練想成這樣的層級。

cues.en: So at the ground level we have pre-training where the model learns syntax and grammar, basic rules
cues.zh: 最底層是預訓練，模型學習句法、文法，以及

cues.en: about what text looks like, what different languages look like, punctuation, and so on.
cues.zh: 文字、不同語言、標點符號等的基本規則。

cues.en: Now at this point, the model has a lot of world knowledge and language knowledge, but it doesn't really do a whole lot.
cues.zh: 到這個階段，模型已有大量世界知識與語言知識，但還不太會做事。

cues.en: Then the goal of fine tuning is to get the model to learn specific tasks, like coding or summarizing,
cues.zh: 接著，微調的目標，是讓模型學會特定任務，例如寫程式、摘要，

cues.en: or classifying or fine tuning on specific areas of knowledge, like medicine or social media marketing or, I don't know, ancient Egyptian history.
cues.zh: 或分類；也可以針對醫學、社群行銷，或古埃及史等特定知識領域微調。

cues.en: And then you can think of instruction tuning as getting the model to express its knowledge in ways that
cues.zh: 再把指令微調想成，讓模型以最有用，且符合

cues.en: are most useful and aligned with human, commercial, and societal values and applications.
cues.zh: 人類、商業與社會價值及應用的方式，表達知識。

cues.en: So one way you can see instruction tuning is that it's like providing an instruction manual for llms for exactly how they should interact with their users.
cues.zh: 所以，可以把指令微調看成替 LLM 提供操作手冊，明確告訴它應該如何與使用者互動。

cues.en: Instruction tuning is also where models learn constraints, like denying requests to help with illegal or unethical activities.
cues.zh: 指令微調也是模型學習限制的階段，例如拒絕協助非法或不道德活動的要求。
